purpose: Expose immutable company-scoped Access History and provide guarded prior-access recovery without creating a second authorization or audit authority.
security_boundaries: Access History requires access.audit.view and is company-scoped
access recovery requires access.audit.view plus access.users.manage
self-recovery is forbidden and Company Owner protections remain authoritative
only a supported immutable event before-snapshot can be recovered
historical Access Profile and every selected scope record are revalidated against current company/lifecycle state
identity fields and credentials are never restored from audit JSON
successful recovery increments security_version and appends a new immutable access.user.access_restored event
